title: Advanced Course Pathways Compared
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Compare Advanced Placement, the International Baccalaureate, and dual enrollment on sign-up, commitment, assessment, college credit, and fit, and find the pathway that matches your situation.

learningObjectives: Students will compare AP, IB, and dual enrollment and differentiate among them by structure, commitment, how they are assessed, and how college credit is earned.
prerequisites: Chapter 7: Your Senior Year Course Load

controls: AP, IB, and DE tab buttons (narrow screens)

keyQuestions: Why might a dual-enrollment grade matter more later than an AP class grade?
When is the IB Diploma worth its extra hours?
How does your school profile help a college read whichever pathway you choose?
commonMisconceptions: One pathway is always more impressive to colleges.
AP, IB, and dual enrollment credits transfer the same way everywhere.
assessmentOpportunities: Students choose a pathway for a described student and justify it using two rows of the comparison.
